_about: Footnotes shown on the leaderboard. They never change official scores or results/*.json.

notes.text: Codex: 7/10 official, 9/10 with grader artifact corrected (make-mips-interpreter and make-doom-for-mips). Both official misses came from the Terminal-Bench grader trusting a stale /tmp/frame.bmp and cutting DOOM's output off after ~1 second; $0 verifier-only re-grades of the same shipped files (no model calls) each passed 3/3. make-doom still officially timed out, so the official score stays 7/10.
